picture_book.instructional_kernel: Ninereeds begins a bounded instructional greeting and identity-verification chain with Taro. The chain's persistent goal is to establish and verify Ninereeds's stable identity across the later interlocutor transition. Pages 01-04 establish the greeting and identity exchange with Taro; page 04 affirmatively confirms Ninereeds but has no meeting-close form, so the identity-verification chain remains open. At page 05 the visible scene changes to a full Ninereeds-Emma pair, and Emma advances the same unresolved goal by rejecting Taro as Ninereeds's identity, requesting self-identification, and offering an Emma-or-Ninereeds discrimination. The ordered two-person scenes carry one persistent identity event across the transition. Page 08 is the sole resolution: Emma says 'Nice to meet you.' and Ninereeds says 'Nice to meet you, too.'. The bounded identity-verification chain stops with Ninereeds and Emma as the visible pair.

story_arc.initial_state_or_goal: Ninereeds begins a bounded instructional greeting and identity-verification chain with Taro. The chain's persistent goal is to establish and verify Ninereeds's stable identity across the later interlocutor transition.
story_arc.meaningful_development: Pages 01-04 establish the greeting and identity exchange with Taro; page 04 affirmatively confirms Ninereeds but has no meeting-close form, so the identity-verification chain remains open. A dedicated hand-off page visibly shows Taro giving the same Ninereeds phone to Emma while both identify themselves. Emma then advances the same unresolved goal by rejecting Taro as Ninereeds's identity, requesting self-identification, and offering an Emma-or-Ninereeds discrimination.
story_arc.resolution_or_stopping_state: Page 08 is the sole resolution: Emma says 'Nice to meet you.' and Ninereeds says 'Nice to meet you, too.'. The bounded identity-verification chain stops with Ninereeds and Emma as the visible pair.
story_arc.coherence_test: Page 04 is affirmative and unresolved; removing the visible Taro-to-Emma phone hand-off breaks the causal connection to Emma's continuation; page 08 is the sole closing ritual and resolution.
